svg.title: The windgram package — typed data in, chart out
svg.desc: A twelve-line TypeScript example that validates a profile and serializes a chart, beside the exact SVG the package renders from a committed scenario profile.

svg.aria-label: Windgram for Synthetic Front Ridge, model front-arrival, 2000-01-01 1p to 10p (Etc/UTC): surface metric strips above a time-height field; derived series, isotherms, shading overlays and winds aloft are drawn over the profile.
